description: This file defines a mutex class and related synchronization primitives for the quiche project, including lock acquisition and release methods, and notification mechanisms.

classes.name: QuicheMutex
classes.description: A non-reentrant mutex class with methods for locking, unlocking, and asserting lock status.

classes.name: QuicheNotification
classes.description: A class for thread notification of a single event.

classes.name: QuicheReaderMutexLock
classes.description: A helper class that acquires a shared lock on a QuicheMutex within scope.

classes.name: QuicheWriterMutexLock
classes.description: A helper class that acquires an exclusive lock on a QuicheMutex within scope.

methods.name: QuicheMutex::WriterLock
methods.description: Blocks until the mutex is free, then acquires it exclusively.

methods.name: QuicheMutex::WriterUnlock
methods.description: Releases the mutex, which must be held exclusively.

methods.name: QuicheMutex::ReaderLock
methods.description: Blocks until the mutex is free or shared, then acquires a shared lock.

methods.name: QuicheMutex::ReaderUnlock
methods.description: Releases the shared lock on the mutex.

methods.name: QuicheMutex::AssertReaderHeld
methods.description: Checks if the current thread holds the mutex in at least shared mode.

methods.name: QuicheNotification::HasBeenNotified
methods.description: Checks if the notification has been triggered.

methods.name: QuicheNotification::WaitForNotification
methods.description: Waits for the notification to be triggered.
